detail.longDescription: As a web designer who's built dozens of websites in WordPress, I have a confession to make: I'm not really fond of it. WordPress is over two decades old, its foundations are still built on rickety 2003-era technology, and there are a few layers of modern code digitally duct-taped on top. Thousands of unvetted plugins sit in WordPress's marketplace, any one of which could unwittingly (or wittingly) create a security opening for hackers to exploit.
